author: CMS-HGCAL
body:
#### PR description:

These are some fixes to the initial changes to HGCalRecHitCalibrationESProducer.cc to use aging:
- use optional, in case the aging conditions are not required
- wrap all divisions by lsb with a function to avoid divisions by 0 (occurs for the moment in unconnected channels)
- mip scale is in fact `signal * signalScale / lsb`
- cm_slope is available as `xtalk`

#### PR validation:

```shell
cmsRun SimCalorimetry/HGCalSimProducers/test/testAlpakaDigiChain_cfg.py        modules=SimCalorimetry/HGCalSimProducers/data/modulelocator_C01toC06.txt        files=file:/afs/cern.ch/user/p/psilva/public/dpg_hack/step1.root maxEvents=1 applyAgeing=True
```
title: Dev/validate alpaka digis fixcalib
